title: The actual compact-support coefficient transition
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its specified algebra structure. Use the actual quotient rings $A_n=\mathcal O_E/(\ell)^{n+1}$, the strict coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], their ordinary derived categories [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], and the constructible finite-Tor tower category [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Let $k$ be a field of positive characteristic different from $\ell$, and let b,o be the normalized shriek operations of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels]. Fix section-normalized scalar/evaluation coordinates q, finite direct-image coordinates z, and finite normalization data. For a separated finite-type map f between separated finite-type k-schemes and any compactification c, let K be a constructible finite-Tor tower and m ≤ n. Under the prescribed evaluation comparisons, reduction of F_c(K) equals the canonical reduction-direct-image comparison [det-sp-reduction-direct-image] on K_n followed by F_{c,m} of the actual input reduction K_n tensor^L A_m → K_m. This is equality of the actual derived maps in the intrinsic constant-ring coordinates, with the finite comparison normalized by the recorded counits. It asserts neither flatness of A_m over A_n nor recovery of a derived morphism from an arbitrary family of evaluations.

proof.text: Use the actual strict-system direct-image transition formula of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. In restriction-of-scalars form, compact support sends t to F(t) followed by the normalized comparison of [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]. The section coordinates preserve the scalar unit, so transposing this expression identifies it with the reduction map from [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Apply [lem-sp-restriction-transition-transpose] to identify that transpose with the canonical scalar comparison followed by F of input reduction. Conjugating by the prescribed finite evaluation word gives the displayed equality. This does not use detection of equality by evaluations.

theorem reduction_transition_compatibility
    (pchar : ℕ) (hp : 0 < pchar) (hne : pchar ≠ l)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k pchar]
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) (o : SpTowerShriek.Operations l E b)
    (q : Coordinates l E b) (z : FiniteCoordinates l E)
    (finiteData : FiniteNormalization l E k b o q z) :
    (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) (K : C l E b q X) {m n : ℕ} (v : m ≤ n),
    (scalarExtensionFunctor (quotient l E v) Y).map
        ((finiteData.evaluation c n).comparison.hom.app K.obj) ≫
      (reductionDirectImageComparison (quotient l E v) c.i c.g).app
        ((spDerivedCoefficientEvaluation l E X (q.abelian X) n).obj K.obj) ≫
      (reductionCompactSupport (SpTowerShriek.R l E m) c.i c.g).map
        (reduction l E X (q.abelian X) v (q.scalar X v) K.obj) =
    reduction l E Y (q.abelian Y) v (q.scalar Y v) ((F l E b o q c).obj K.obj) ≫
      (finiteData.evaluation c m).comparison.hom.app K.obj)
